title: Real-Time Truck-Induced Strain Monitoring and Intelligent Safety Assessment of a Large-Scale Steel Platform in Hong Kong
content: Steel platforms carrying construction traffic are subjected to repeated moving loads, while their structural response is commonly assessed through periodic inspection rather than continuous measurement. This study presents an Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled framework for monitoring the operational strain response of a sloped steel platform subjected to repeated haul-truck movements. Fifteen vibrating wire strain gauges (VWSGs) were installed on selected rafters, longitudinal members, columns, and diagonal braces. Time-stamped strain measurements were transmitted through a TH-RTU-C IoT gateway and a 4G network to a cloud-based monitoring platform and linked to a sensor-driven digital shadow. An event-preserving processing framework was applied to separate slowly varying strain components from truck-induced transient strain increments and to identify candidate loading events from temporally coordinated multi-sensor responses. A time-stamped field photograph independently documented a reference truck event. Complete-duration event-level distributions showed a strongly nonuniform but recurring spatial response pattern, with these three channels consistently exhibiting the largest local strain increments. The documented event provided a physical reference for interpreting the broader candidate-event distributions observed during routine operation. The sensor-driven digital shadow integrates platform geometry, VWSG locations, near-real-time strain histories, historical event review, and local strain-demand indicators. The interface allows monitored responses to be compared with adopted engineering strain limits and visualized using Normal, Attention, and Critical operational states. The results show that event-level statistical characterization and IoT data transmission can establish operational strain-response envelopes, identify governing monitored locations, and convert continuous strain measurements into operationally interpretable information for steel structures.
